note: Visitors is native self-hosted web analytics. JS tracker posts visits to /visitors/_track (route visitors.track, open access), recorded to the 'visitors' DB table by the visitors.tracker service; visitors.visibility decides what is tracked. Reports at /visitors (permission 'access visitors') use Views + Chart.js (dep charts_chartjs). All behaviour is in the config object visitors.config (NOTE: config name is visitors.config, while the settings FORM route is visitors.settings at /admin/config/system/visitors). Keys include items_per_page, theme, disable_tracking, track.userid, counter.{enabled,entity_types,display_max_age}, visibility.*, script_type, flush_log_timer, bot_retention_log. Permissions: access visitors, opt-out of visitors tracking, view visitors counter. Drush rebuild commands: visitors:rebuild:route / :ip-address / :device (recompute derived data from the log). Submodule visitors_geoip adds geolocation. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the local visitors.config object (items_per_page sentinel 47; counter.entity_types adding 'user'); no external tracking needed.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the Visitors analytics module, and what is the machine name of the config object that stores its settings?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/system/visitors (route visitors.settings, permission 'administer site configuration'), and the settings are stored in the config object visitors.config (note: the config object is visitors.config, not visitors.settings).

evals.prompt: The Visitors module can reprocess its existing log. Which Drush commands does it provide to rebuild derived data such as device and route info?
evals.expected_output: visitors:rebuild:route, visitors:rebuild:ip-address, and visitors:rebuild:device (aliases visitors-rebuild-route/-ip-address/-device) recompute route, IP-address, and device/browser data from the existing visitors log. They mirror the /admin/config/system/visitors/rebuild-* forms.

evals.prompt: What permission lets a user view the Visitors analytics reports, and what other permissions does the module define?
evals.expected_output: 'access visitors' grants access to the reports under /visitors. The module also defines 'opt-out of visitors tracking' (let users opt in/out of tracking) and 'view visitors counter' (see the per-content hit counter).

evals.prompt: On this site, the number of rows shown per page in the Visitors reports has been customised. Inspect the live Visitors configuration and tell me the configured items-per-page value.
On this site the Visitors content hit-counter is configured for more than one entity type. Inspect the live Visitors configuration and list which entity types get a hit counter.
evals.expected_output: The counter is configured for node and user (visitors.config:counter.entity_types = [node, user]).

evals.prompt: Configure the Visitors module so its analytics report pages show 25 rows per page. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: visitors.config:items_per_page == 25 (set on the Visitor Settings form at /admin/config/system/visitors, or `drush config:set visitors.config items_per_page 25`).

evals.prompt: The Visitors content hit-counter currently only counts node views. Configure Visitors so that the 'user' entity type also gets a hit counter, keeping node counted too. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: visitors.config:counter.entity_types includes 'user' (e.g. [node, user]). Read the current array, append 'user', and save it back on visitors.config.
